thread:
maria: Heads-up — opened a cleanup/refactor PR that splits serializers into smaller modules and tidies exports. No behavioral changes intended, mostly moves + type hints. Would appreciate another pair of eyes for style and import-cycle risk.
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4237

chris: thanks for the ping. I'll try to skim it today. is this blocking the next release or just nice-to-have?

maria: nice-to-have but would prefer it merged before next week's release window (keeps diff smaller for subsequent PRs). Main worry is I might've accidentally re-ordered params on SerializerV1.__init__ — I left a shim but want someone to validate.

david: can you call out the public API surface you touched? i'll run the compat test matrix.

maria: sure — public changes are limited to:
- moved serializers/*.py -> serializers/{base,registry,compact}.py
- exported Serializer, SerializerV1, register_serializer
- added small deprecation shim in serializers/__init__.py

I also updated some type hints in registry.py, no new deps.

david: cool. i'll run the compat tests locally:
```
python -m pytest tests/serializers/test_compat.py -q
```
should let us catch constructor changes.

jen: fyi CI has been a bit flaky on macOS lately, so if you see one red mac job don't panic — retrying is usually enough.

ci-bot: [CI] PR #4237 — linux/py39: ✅ passed, macos/py39: ❌ failed (flake: tests/serializers/test_registry.py::test_register_returns_existing)

chris: looks related — test_registry relies on import ordering in one spot. At a glance, registry import timing changed because of the module move. Suggest changing the test to import from the public API instead of relative module path, or add an explicit import in registry to avoid race.

maria: thanks — pushed a small test fix and added an explicit "from .registry import _ensure_loaded" in serializers/__init__.py to preserve load order.

maria: updated branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4237/commits/3b7a9c

david: re-ran compat tests locally — all green for me. nice and small.

chris: gave a quick code review. left two nits (trailing comma and a docstring tweak). nothing blocking.

jen: i'll wait for CI to go green once more, then i'll squash & merge. ping me if you want it merged sooner.

ci-bot: [CI] PR #4237 — macos/py39: ✅ passed

jen: merging now (squash, commit message: "refactor(serializers): modularize serializers + export shims") — merged as 5f4b1c8

maria: thanks everyone 🙏 — appreciate the quick eyes!
